header.cleanBody:
This card and you are unaffected by any effect other than this card's effect, this card can't be used on Your Turn, and is banished from the game after its effect resolves.

When your deck becomes zero due to opposing effects, you can immediately use this card, return every card in your Trash and all your banished cards to the deck and shuffle it. Also, during this turn, your deck is unaffected by opposing effects. These effects can't be prevented by either player's effects.

header.cleanBody:
This card and you are unaffected by any effect other than this card's effect, and this card can't be used on Your Turn.

When your deck would be discarded by opposing effects, or when your Life would become zero due to the opponent, by banishing this card from game, immediately end this turn. Also, when your Life would become zero, your Life would become one and the cores would be sent to the Reserve. Neither player can activate effects/Burst effects via this effect.
